fm.title: Jipda components
fm.description: Modular JIPDA tracker building blocks (6 blocks)

rows.intent: Assign detections to tracks using JIPDA probabilities — use as a modular component in custom JIPDA tracker pipelines
Initiate new tracks from unassigned detections — use as a modular component for track birth in JIPDA tracker designs
Manage track lifecycle based on existence probability — use for confirming or deleting tracks in modular JIPDA pipelines
Output confirmed tracks from the JIPDA tracker — use for extracting finalized track estimates from modular JIPDA designs
Predict track states forward in time — use for the prediction step in modular JIPDA tracker pipelines
Update track states with new measurements — use for the measurement update step in modular JIPDA tracker pipelines

rows.block: Global Nearest Neighbor Multi Object Tracker
rows.ref: motalgorithmslib/Global Nearest Neighbor Multi Object Tracker
rows.intent: Track multiple objects using GNN data association — use for simple multi-target tracking when targets are well-separated
Track objects on a spatial occupancy grid — use for tracking extended targets or dense environments with grid-based representations

rows.block: Joint Probabilistic Data Association Multi Object Tracker
rows.ref: motalgorithmslib/Joint Probabilistic Data Association Multi Object Tracker
rows.intent: Track multiple objects using JPDA soft association — use for cluttered environments where detections may originate from multiple targets
Track unknown number of objects using PHD filter — use when target count varies and explicit track management is impractical
Track objects using multiple hypothesis trees — use for high-accuracy tracking in dense clutter with deferred association decisions
Fuse tracks from multiple trackers into a unified track set — use for combining outputs from distributed sensors or tracking nodes
Evaluate tracker performance using GOSPA metric — use for quantifying tracking accuracy including missed and false tracks
Evaluate tracker performance using OSPA metric — use for measuring the overall distance between estimated and ground-truth track sets

fm.title: Scenario utilities
fm.description: Scenario readers, sensors, and data utilities (5 blocks)

rows.intent: Simulate a radar sensor generating detections from a scenario — use for creating synthetic radar measurements for tracker testing
Extract platform poses from a tracking scenario — use for feeding ground-truth platform positions into sensor models
Read and replay a saved tracking scenario — use for loading pre-configured multi-platform scenarios into Simulink for testing
Merge detection lists from multiple sensors — use for combining detections before feeding into a centralized tracker
Merge track lists from multiple trackers — use for combining tracks before feeding into a track-to-track fuser

fm.title: Sensor target models
fm.description: Sensor and target specification models (8 blocks)

rows.intent: Define where new targets can appear in the surveillance volume — use for configuring target birth distributions in PHD trackers
Define the false alarm distribution and density — use for characterizing spurious detections in the sensor field of view
Define sensor detection probability as a function of target state — use for modeling range-dependent or aspect-dependent detection likelihood
Define the sensor measurement function — use for mapping target state to expected sensor observations in tracking filters
Bundle sensor models into a complete specification — use for combining measurement, clutter, and detectability models for a sensor
Define target dynamics and motion model — use for specifying how targets move between time steps in tracking filters
Define target survival probability over time — use for modeling how likely targets persist between frames in PHD trackers
Bundle target models into a complete specification — use for combining state transition, survival, and birth models for targets
